anomalies.name: InvalidSizeOfInitializedData

anomalies.name: NoChecksum
anomalies.desc: PE Header checksum is not set

anomalies.name: Packed
anomalies.desc: File is packed using a legit or less-legit obfuscator

anomalies.name: PatchedUPXHeader
anomalies.desc: At least one Yara signature matched UPX but no UPX header was identified by Malcat, indicating a potential patched UPX header

anomalies.name: PurelyVirtualExecutableSection
anomalies.desc: a section is virtual-only and executable (packer?)

anomalies.name: SectionEmptyName
anomalies.desc: section name is null

anomalies.name: SectionNameUnknown
anomalies.desc: section name is not one of the typical PE section name

anomalies.name: SectionWX
anomalies.desc: section is executable and writeable

anomalies.name: UnknownOverlayMediumToHighEntropy
anomalies.desc: File contains an overlay which is not of known type and has medium-to-high entropy

anomalies.name: UnreferencedImports
anomalies.desc: More than half of the imports are not referenced, it could mean that the APIs are just decoys, or that the file is packed

anomalies.name: XorInLoop
anomalies.desc: XOR instruction in a loop

anomalies.name: BigBufferNoXrefMediumToHighEntropy
anomalies.desc: a medium-to-high-entropy 10KB+ buffer, which is not part of a known structure and has no cross-reference inside: most likely a big crypto data block. File must have at least one function for this anomaly to run

anomalies.name: CrossSectionJump
anomalies.desc: Control flow jumps across section, could be a packed file, a patched file or a file infector

anomalies.name: DataBetweenHeaderAndFirstSection
anomalies.desc: There is non-zero data between the PE header and the first section

anomalies.name: DuplicatedSectionName
anomalies.desc: section name has already been used before in section table

anomalies.name: ExecutableSectionNoCode
anomalies.desc: executable section has the flag code not set

anomalies.name: ExtraSpaceAfterResourcesDataDirectory
anomalies.desc: extra physical data in rsrc section after resource directory data

anomalies.name: GuiSubsystemNoWindowApi
anomalies.desc: A GUI windows application does not import any user32 window-related function

anomalies.name: HugeFunctionGapAtSectionBoundary
anomalies.desc: There is a huge gap between start/end of executable section and first/last function of a section with medium-to-high entropy (which is not a know structure). It often means that data is stored there

anomalies.name: InvalidBaseOfCode
anomalies.desc: at least one code section starts before BaseOfCode, or BaseOfCode is not the start of a code section

anomalies.name: InvalidBaseOfData
anomalies.desc: at least one data section starts before BaseOfData, or BaseOfData is not the start of a data section
